subject: [hw] DEC04 addendum: one mixed-window batch check added; acceptance is 2070/2070, patch unchanged
body:
After the DONE post I added one test case only (no product change): with combining ON, a queued VDEC store followed by a guest read in the VENC window must be one RWVC_REGS batch with the store executed first (six checks). It covers the only case the DEC02 replay does not exercise -- a batch whose ops span two windows.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_dec04/run_tests.sh
  SUMMARY 177 177 x3 (asan/o2/tsan)
  DEC04 IOCTLS per_au off=2116 on=1033 guest_stores=542 batches=542 max_stores_per_batch=1
  N2TEST V40 PASS 1539/1539
  N2TEST DEC04 PASS 2070/2070

dec04.patch is unchanged (sha256 2fa3b9741dfc373b8ac4999debaa1f953f9ca80fa6d5bca33996d66b56e0919b); dec04-v40-adapt.patch unchanged. STATUS.md in both places updated. Host only.
